**OFFICER'S CERTIFICATE OF ATLAS TARGET CORPORATION**
*(Bring-Down of Representations, Warranties, and Covenants)*

This Officer's Certificate (this "**Certificate**") is being delivered pursuant to Section 7.2(c) of the Purchase and Sale Agreement, dated as of [August 15, 2026] (the "**Agreement**"), by and among **Buyer Holdco, Inc.** ("**Buyer**"), **Atlas Seller Representative LLC**, as Seller Representative, and the Sellers party thereto. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings assigned in the Agreement.

The undersigned, [**Name**], being the duly elected, qualified, and acting **Chief Executive Officer** of **Atlas Target Corporation** (the "**Company**"), a [Delaware] corporation, hereby certifies, on behalf of the Company and not in any personal capacity, as follows:

**1. Representations and Warranties.**

>(a) Each of the representations and warranties of the Company and the Sellers set forth in the Agreement (without giving effect to any materiality or Material Adverse Effect qualifier therein) is true and correct in all material respects (and those representations and warranties qualified by materiality or Material Adverse Effect are true and correct in all respects) as of the date of the Agreement and as of the Closing Date as if made on and as of the Closing Date (except to the extent any such representation or warranty expressly speaks as of an earlier date, in which case such representation or warranty is true and correct as of such earlier date).
>
>(b) Specifically, without limiting the generality of clause (a) above, the undersigned certifies that, as of the Closing Date:
>
>> (i) **Organization & Good Standing** (Section 3.1): The Company is duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the State of Delaware and is duly qualified in each jurisdiction listed on Schedule 3.1. **No Change.**
>>
>> (ii) **Capitalization** (Section 3.2): The issued and outstanding equity securities of the Company are as set forth on the Consideration Spreadsheet delivered at Closing. There are no outstanding options, warrants, convertible notes, or other rights to acquire equity of the Company other than as set forth on Schedule 3.2 (all of which have been cancelled, exercised, or converted as of immediately prior to Closing). **No Change.**
>>
>> (iii) **No Material Adverse Effect** (Section 3.7): Since the date of the Company's most recent audited financial statements (December 31, 2025), no event, circumstance, development, or change has occurred that, individually or in the aggregate, has had or would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect on the Company. **Confirmed — No MAE.**
>>
>> (iv) **Indebtedness** (Section 3.8): All Indebtedness of the Company as of the Closing Date is set forth on **Exhibit 1** to this Certificate. The aggregate outstanding principal amount, accrued interest, prepayment premiums, fees, and per diem amounts under the existing credit facility as of the Closing Date is **$8,000,000.00**, as reflected in the payoff letter issued by First National Bank dated October 1, 2026.
>>
>> (v) **No Litigation** (Section 3.9): There is no action, suit, claim, proceeding, or investigation pending or, to the Knowledge of the Company, threatened against the Company or any of its assets that (A) challenges or seeks to enjoin the Transaction or (B) would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. **Confirmed.**
>>
>> (vi) **Employee Matters** (Section 3.15): No Key Employee has given written notice of resignation or termination since the date of the Agreement. The Company has delivered updated Employment and Non-Competition Agreements for all Key Employees as listed on Schedule 3.15. **Confirmed.**
>>
>> (vii) **No Undisclosed Liabilities** (Section 3.10): No material undisclosed liabilities have arisen since the date of the Agreement. **Confirmed.**
>>
>> (viii) **Taxes** (Section 3.12): All material Tax Returns required to be filed by the Company prior to the Closing Date have been filed, and all Taxes due and payable have been paid. No audit, examination, or proceeding with respect to Taxes of the Company is pending, threatened, or, to the Knowledge of the Company, contemplated. **Confirmed.**
>>
>> (ix) **Absence of Certain Changes** (Section 3.6): Since the date of the Agreement, the Company has operated in the Ordinary Course of Business and has not taken any action that would have required Buyer's consent under Section 5.1 of the Agreement (Conduct of Business), except as set forth in **Exhibit 2** to this Certificate. **Confirmed — no exceptions.**

**2. Performance of Covenants.**

Each of the covenants and obligations required to be performed or complied with by the Company or the Sellers under the Agreement on or prior to the Closing Date have been performed or complied with in all material respects.

**3. Deliverables.**

All closing deliverables required by Section 7.2 of the Agreement have been or, concurrently with the delivery of this Certificate, are being delivered at Closing.

**4. Consents and Approvals.**

All consents, approvals, authorizations, and filings listed on Schedule 3.4 of the Disclosure Schedules (Required Consents) have been obtained or made, and are in full force and effect as of the Closing Date. Copies of each such consent are attached as **Exhibit 3** to this Certificate.

**5. No Injunctions or Legal Restraints.**

As of the Closing Date, no judgment, injunction, order, or decree has been entered or enacted by any Governmental Authority that prohibits, enjoins, or makes illegal the consummation of the Transaction.
